protocol.one_question_per_batch_justification: JevXForDecision.forward shares one question across the state batch, so a batch is a set of states asking the SAME question; the option count is therefore uniform and no padded option column is produced. --phase shared-state shows the m-question call gives per-question logits BITWISE EQUAL to the per-question calls, so this protocol is the same computation as the genuine multi-question forward.
protocol.head_init: every arm starts from bitwise-identical head weights (torch.manual_seed(1234) before the wrapper is built)
